meta.name: histolab
meta.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

copy.tagline: 从病理切片中提取组织块并预处理图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理H&E染色切片并提取组织块用于下游分析
copy.tagline_en: Extract tissue tiles from pathology slides and preprocess images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with H&E stained slides and need to extract tissue tiles for downstream analysis

howto.what: Histolab能让Claude处理全切片图像（如SVS、TIFF），自动检测组织区域，提取小图块，并准备用于深度学习的数据集。还支持染色归一化。
howto.when: 当用户需要处理H&E染色的全切片图像，进行组织检测、图块提取或染色归一化时触发。适合简单的数据处理和数据集准备。

say.note: 将输出512x512像素的图块到指定文件夹。

say.text: 用Macenko方法对这张切片做染色归一化。
say.note: 需要提供一张参考染色图像。

say.text: 对这个全切片进行网格状图块提取，重叠像素为0。

howto.what_en: Histolab enables Claude to process whole slide images (WSI), automatically detect tissue regions, extract tiles, and prepare datasets for deep learning. It also supports stain normalization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to process H&E-stained WSIs for tissue detection, tile extraction, or stain normalization. Suitable for simple pipelines and dataset preparation.

say_en.note: Outputs 512x512 pixel tiles to the specified folder.
